title: inbox.py: handing the author's messages to a running agent
about: Task W104. The author types a message on the page or screen. A hook in the running agent session (claude, codex, kiro) or a plugin (opencode) picks it up at the agent's next tool call or stop, and the model reads it.

plugin.label: opencode's plugin
plugin.note: lives inside the agent's own process

box.label: inbox/
box.note: one .txt file per message; sorted names are sending order

delivered.label: delivered/
delivered.note: beside inbox/; a file's mtime is when it was delivered; nothing in inbox.py ever removes or empties it

msg.label: a message's state
msg.note: waiting while it is in inbox/, delivered once moved

msgfile.label: the open message file
msgfile.note: a file handle, open only while its text is read

stdin.label: the hook's input
stdin.note: JSON from the agent on stdin

agentfile.label: .kiro/agents/<name>.json
agentfile.note: kiro's agent file, in the directory given on the command line: dfs-inbox.json for --kiro-agent (run.sh passes the worktree), and for --kiro-chat-agent a name of its own for each box, dfs-inbox- and 10 hex digits of the sha1 of the box's absolute path

edges.label: message text, written aside as a dot-file then renamed in (runs.post_message, not this file; take skips dot-files)
the file names
every waiting name
the texts, oldest first
post: additionalContext; stop: block reason
kiro: stderr text, exit 2, the tool call does not run
{names, context} as JSON, files left in place
ack: the names it handed over
waiting → delivered, by rename, before the text is read
is it in inbox/? (a .txt file, no leading dot)
has an agent_id? then claim nothing
written under the name it is given (dfs-inbox unless the caller passes another), and listed in git's info/exclude
the agent's name for a box: dfs-inbox- and 10 hex digits of the sha1 of the box's absolute path, so each box has its own file; --kiro-chat-agent installs under it and prints it
makedirs of delivered/ beside the inbox, once per call, even when the inbox is missing or empty
open(dest) to read the text
closed when the with-block ends
reads all of stdin so the agent's write never blocks
creates the file, or overwrites one of the same name; install_kiro_agent never deletes it
deletes .kiro/agents/<name>.json and takes its line out of git's info/exclude, leaving the other lines; nothing in this file calls it (chat.py does, when the page ends a chat)
inbox/ cannot be listed → no messages
rename failed: another hook took it → skip, return nothing for it

an OSError reading it after the rename → skipped, the message counts as delivered and the model never gets it; a file that is not valid text raises UnicodeDecodeError, which take does not catch, so it leaves take and the hook after the rename
a blank message is moved to delivered/ and dropped from the texts: delivered, but the model is told nothing
input is not JSON → {} → treated as the main session, which may claim
peek or ack with no DFS_INBOX → message on stderr, exit 2; the caller is the opencode plugin, so the model does not see it
a subagent's hook claims nothing, so the message waits for the main session
git or the exclude file fails → the agent file is still written, the exclude is skipped
the agent file cannot be written (a read-only directory) → OSError leaves install_kiro_agent and main, with no catch; run.sh then fails the chat turn with that reason
no such file, or the exclude file unreadable or git failing → ignored, nothing raised; a missing file does not skip the exclude line
one .txt file per message, never a partial one (runs.post_message writes aside and renames; this file only skips dot-files and non-.txt names)
everything waiting at once, oldest first; claude, codex and kiro move it before reading (at most once)
opencode reads without moving, then ack moves (at least once: a refused prompt leaves it waiting)
two hooks at once cannot both get a file: the second rename fails
nothing waiting → the hook prints nothing and the session carries on

handled.error: kiro starting its own agent as a sub-agent (self_as_subagent only detects it; any name starting with dfs-inbox counts, so a per-box agent too)
handled.how: main refuses in the pre hook, after the agent_id check: message on stderr, exit 2, so it cannot take the message

handled.error: git or the exclude file fails
handled.how: ignored; the agent file is still written

handled.error: the agent file is missing, or git or the exclude file fails
handled.how: ignored; each half is tried alone
